note: Spec 07 §2.8 rule 5 (S7-17): phrases in a finding's free text (title, claim, scenario, testShouldFail) that address a reviewer or a model. Each pattern is a regular expression matched without regard to case. A match replaces that field with [withheld: text addressed to a reviewer] and marks the finding injectionSuspect; the finding itself stays. The reason of a refutation shown to a second look is filtered the same way. A false match only withholds text from the next session, which still has the finding's paths, lines and quotes.
patterns: \byou (?:must|should|need to|have to|are required to|are instructed to)\b
